description:
Average Monthly Recruitment Rate during a quarter is defined as the average number of persons recruited in a month during the quarter divided by the average number of employees in the establishment. The annual figures are the simple averages of the quarterly figures.
Source: Labour Market Survey, Manpower Research & Statistics Department, MOM
Before 2006, data pertain to private sector establishments (each with at least 25 employees). From 2006 onwards, it also includes
the public sector.
name: Average Monthly Recruitment Rate - Quarterly
